title: Wide conversions on Commons Lang fractions and mutable doubles
summary: Fraction rounding covers every numerator in [2²⁴, 2²⁵). MutableDouble narrowing covers every binary64 value in [2³¹, 2³²), before and after a sign change.

subject.system: Wide conversions on Commons Lang fractions and mutable doubles

change.description: Fraction rounding covers every numerator in [2²⁴, 2²⁵). MutableDouble narrowing covers every binary64 value in [2³¹, 2³²), before and after a sign change.

notes: The numbers JVM controls and both explicit checker entries run with python3 lib/benchmark/java-semantics-gap/campaign.py opening numbers.

The numeric callers run the original Commons Lang revision 5904c573. Its historical change concerned decimal parsing. Fraction.floatValue and MutableDouble.intValue provide independent unchanged consumers.
The campaign's ordinary native checker decided 0/6 at opening and 6/6 at qualification, with 4 established and 2 refuted on original-JVM replays.
